R/D wire line equipment. Disconnected top riser and removed wire line BOP.
R/D wire line equipment. Removed spool and riser joint from x-mas tree.
Installed half moon on F-15 and secured same.
Flushed lines with 1 m3 packer fluid
Installed tree cap and needle valve on xmas tree.
Started to pressure test x-mas tree, DHSV, MMV and HMV. according to procedure.
Bullheaded 3 m3 100 % meg, 6,6 m3 packer fluid and 1,2 m3 100 % meg.
Performed inflow test on DHSV, MMV and HMV.
R/D chicksan lines and valves from x-mas tree.
Pressure tested x-mas tree cap to 250 bar.
Cleared well head area for excces equipment.

Prepared and handed over well to production. Await decision for F-1 operation.
Operation completed continued operation on 15/9 F-99. Await decision for F-1 operation.
